purpose: Teach: 配給/ジャーナリズム/公衆/リアルタイム/真っ赤/隠す/断念/上る

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時の、本気で、絶対、配給、絶対、医療物資、絶対、貴重でしたよ、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, during wartime, medical supplies were genuinely precious. Thank you for understanding that.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. Clear historical weight without sentimentality. Eyes level, speaking to someone who will actually listen.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療界の、本気で、絶対、ジャーナリズム、絶対、医師、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、対応されますよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Journalism in medicine — doctors have to respond carefully to every inquiry, don't they? I really appreciate that, sensei.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft recognition of the complexity. Genuine gratitude, not flattery. Slight hesitation like he's choosing his words carefully.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。公衆、絶対、衛生、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Public health protocols — we maintain those standards rigorously across the entire medical team.
lines.style: Direct, professional clarity. Not lecturing but informing. Measured pace. The voice of someone explaining what they do daily with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: リアルタイム、絶対、心電図、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、活用、絶対、されていますよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Real-time monitoring with ECGs — the medical team uses that data actively, doesn't it? I'm genuinely impressed by that, sensei.
lines.style: Curious but not naive. Leaning slightly forward intellectually. Recognizing something he hadn't fully considered before. Warm appreciation underneath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの顔色が、本気で、絶対、真っ赤、絶対、になる時、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、注意します、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When a patient's face shows signs of distress — when they flush like that — the team picks up on it immediately.
lines.style: Observational, clinical but not cold. A small example offered as teaching. Slight warmth in acknowledging she notices what others might miss.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者さんが、本気で、絶対、症状を、絶対、隠す、絶対、こと、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、気を付けますよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Patients often hide their symptoms, don't they — the medical team has to stay alert to that. I imagine that takes real care, sensei.
lines.style: Hesitant recognition of something difficult. Not accusatory, just observant. Genuine appreciation for the unseen labour it requires.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。延命治療を、本気で、絶対、断念、絶対、するご家族の決断、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、寄り添います、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When families have to make the decision to stop life-extending treatment — the team stands with them through that.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. Each phrase lands with weight. Not solemn but deeply present. The voice of someone who has witnessed this and held space for it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 手術件数が、本気で、絶対、上る、絶対、時期、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、お忙しいですよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: During peak surgical seasons, the workload must become enormous. I'm genuinely grateful for how the team carries that, sensei.
lines.style: Final reflective acknowledgment. Soft conclusion. Recognizing exhaustion without pity. A moment of witness. Trailing slightly into silence.
